verse.verse_1: Verily We! We have sent it down on the night of Power.
verse.verse_2: And what shall make thee know that which the night of Power is?
verse.verse_3: The night of Power is better than a thousand months.
verse.verse_4: The angels and the spirit descend therein by the command of their Lord with His decrees for every affair.
verse.verse_5: It is all peace, until the rising of the dawn.
